stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

 "path": "/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-openclawlearner-1792545096/attempts/0b0069f7fea24c91b12672bdee6d26d4/system/state/workspace/programs/task-2600bd4e.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Project beams inward from the two edge bars; marker hits consume lanes."""
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in g for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    # The edge bars share a color; isolated non-background cells are the markers.
    edge_counts = Counter(v for r in (0, h - 1) for v in g[r] if v != bg)
    bar_color = edge_counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    marks = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if g[r][c] != bg and g[r][c] != bar_color]
    if not marks:
        return g
    ink = g[marks[0][0]][marks[0][1]]
    n = len(marks)

    def project(edge_row, direction):
        cols = [c for c, v in enumerate(g[edge_row]) if v == bar_color]
        if not cols:
            return
        # Use the rightmost marker-count lanes of the border bar.
        lanes = set(cols[-min(n, len(cols)):])
        r = edge_row + direction
        while 0 <= r < h and r != (h - 1 if edge_row == 0 else 0):
            hit = [c for c in lanes if g[r][c] == ink]
            for c in lanes:
                if c in hit:
                    g[r][c] = 4
                elif g[r][c] == bg:
                    g[r][c] = ink
            lanes.difference_update(hit)
            r += direction

    project(0, 1)
    project(h - 1, -1)
    return g
"
}
